title: Sumax Engineering IPO Details
intro:
Sumax Engineering IPO is a book build issue of ₹53.40 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.43 crore shares aggregating to ₹43.34 crores and offer for sale of 0.10 crore shares aggregating to ₹10.06 crores.

Sumax Engineering IPO opens for subscription on Aug 25, 2026 and closes on Aug 28, 2026. The allotment for the Sumax Engineering IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 31, 2026. Sumax Engineering IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 2, 2026.

Sumax Engineering IPO is set issue price band at ₹95 to ₹101 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,42,400 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,63,600.

GYR Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company are Giriraj Stock Broking Pvt.Ltd. , Mansi Share & Stock Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Sumax Engineering IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 1994, Sumax Engineering Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of products for the Automotive OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) and Auto Refinish markets. The company operates through two segments: manufacturing and trading.

Its manufacturing portfolio includes adhesive tapes and die-cuts, pre-taped masking films, rubbing and polishing compounds, buffing and foam pads, reflective tapes, domes and graphics, and car care products.
Through its trading business, the company supplies electrical and pneumatic tools, abrasive sheets, discs and rolls, body shop consumables, retail products, accessories, and aerosol products.
The company operates two manufacturing units, located in Sriperumbudur, Tamil Nadu, and IMT Manesar, Haryana.

It has a market presence across 26 states and Union Territories in India and exports its products to markets including Thailand, South Korea, Russia, Turkey, China, Vietnam, the United States, Saudi Arabia, and Taiwan.
As of March 31, 2026, the company had 121 employees.

faqs.question: How to apply in Sumax Engineering IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Sumax Engineering IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Sumax Engineering IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Sumax Engineering IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Sumax Engineering IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Sumax Engineering IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Sumax Engineering IPO opens on Tue, Aug 25, 2026 and closes on Fri, Aug 28, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Sumax Engineering IPO?
faqs.answer: Sumax Engineering IPO lot size is 1200 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,42,400 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Sumax Engineering IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Sumax Engineering IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Sumax Engineering IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Sumax Engineering IPO will be done on Monday, August 31, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 1, 2026 . Check the Sumax Engineering IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Sumax Engineering IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Sumax Engineering IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Sep 2, 2026 .
